006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunctionExecutor;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.AbstractAtomicOrUnionType;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
020import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
021import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * Implements the XPath 3.1
026 * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#casting">casting
027 * functions</a>.
028 *
029 * @param <ITEM>
030 *          the Metapath atomic item's Java type
031 */
032public final class CastFunction<ITEM extends IAnyAtomicItem> implements IFunctionExecutor {
033  @NonNull
034  private final IAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM> castExecutor;
035
036  @NonNull
037  static <ITEM extends IAnyAtomicItem> IFunction signature(
038      @NonNull IEnhancedQName name,
039      @NonNull IAtomicOrUnionType<?> resultingAtomicType,
040      @NonNull IAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM> executor) {
041    return signature(name.getNamespace(), name.getLocalName(), resultingAtomicType, executor);
042  }
043
044  @NonNull
045  static <ITEM extends IAnyAtomicItem> IFunction signature(
046      @NonNull String namespace,
047      @NonNull String name,
048      @NonNull IAtomicOrUnionType<?> resultingAtomicType,
049      @NonNull IAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM> executor) {
050    return IFunction.builder()
051        .name(name)
052        .namespace(namespace)
053        .deterministic()
054        .contextIndependent()
055        .focusIndependent()
056        .argument(IArgument.builder()
057            .name("arg1")
058            .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
059            .zeroOrOne()
060            .build())
061        .returnType(resultingAtomicType)
062        .returnZeroOrOne()
063        .functionHandler(newCastExecutor(executor))
064        .build();
065  }
066
067  @NonNull
068  private static <ITEM extends IAnyAtomicItem> CastFunction<ITEM>
069      newCastExecutor(@NonNull IAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM> executor) {
070    return new CastFunction<>(executor);
071  }
072
073  private CastFunction(@NonNull AbstractAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM> castExecutor) {
074    this.castExecutor = castExecutor;
075  }
076
077  @Override
078  public ISequence<ITEM> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
079      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
080      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
081      IItem focus) {
082
083    ISequence<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> arg = FunctionUtils.asType(
084        ObjectUtils.notNull(arguments.get(0)));
085
086    IAnyAtomicItem item = arg.getFirstItem(true);
087    if (item == null) {
088      return ISequence.empty();
089    }
090
091    ITEM castItem = castExecutor.cast(item);
092    return ISequence.of(castItem);
093  }
094}
